A.staff: Mara and Tomas (guides) and the meeting-point desk
A.cust: Alex M. (a visitor) · other guests · a school's teacher

B.staff: Mara and Hugo (guides who meet at hotels and piers) and Lena (licensed driver)
B.cust: Alex M. (books for the group) · guests
B.other: Others (a hotel, a cruise line, a school)

pf.license.need: if: no state licenses tour guiding itself; where the local rules license sightseeing guides, each guide holds that license; driven tours need the vehicle rules (a commercial driver's license with a passenger endorsement for larger vans, and the company's passenger-carrier authority, federal for trips that cross state lines); tours inside a park or on protected land need the land manager's permit
pf.license.who: the business, for any tour operator permit, the passenger-carrier authority and park permits; each guide, for a local guide license where one is required; each driver, for their commercial license and medical card
pf.license.ask: the business registration; any tour operator permit; for driven tours, the carrier number; each park permit with the places and dates it covers; each guide's local license number where required; each driver's license class
pf.license.check: Rosie checks no license, permit or carrier number: each one is the business's own word, shown as that, never as a state license or as checked
pf.license.scope: a guide is offered only for the places the business says their license covers; a park tour only on the dates the permit covers; a driven tour only with a driver the business says is licensed for that vehicle
pf.license.blocks: walking tours go live on identity and the business's registration; a driven tour or a park tour is booked only once the owner says its paper is on file
pf.license.renewals: licenses, permits, carrier insurance and drivers' medical cards: reminded 30 and 7 days before; a lapse the owner reports takes that guide, driver, vehicle or park off new bookings
pf.license.vehicles: each van has its own registration and safety inspection kept current, and its seat count sets the most guests
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance: the business's own word, shown once it's sent; for driven tours, the vehicle insurance the carrier rules require

pf.services.shape: class: seats on a tour departure at a set time from a meeting point, with a set number of seats and a smallest group to run; a private tour books a guide's time for one group, at a meeting point or picked up at the group's hotel, home or cruise pier (flow B)
pf.services.examples: the example operator's own prices (Lee City Tours and Lee Van Tours), not a standard

list.name: Old Town walking tour
list.where: meets at the fountain on Market Square; ends at the old church
list.after: nothing more; any tip is the guest's choice, in cash

list.name: Food tasting walking tour
list.note: food allergies asked on the secure page; the stops are the operator's partner restaurants

list.name: Evening brewery walk (21 and over)
list.where: meets at the fountain on Market Square
list.note: every guest shows a photo ID at the meeting point

list.name: Free walking tour (pay what you wish)
list.price: free; guests tip the guide what they wish
list.where: meets at the fountain on Market Square
list.before: nothing taken; a yes by text
list.after: tips in cash, the guide's own way

list.name: City highlights van tour
list.capacity: 14 seats (the van's seat count); runs with 6
list.note: a guide and a licensed driver, or one guide licensed to drive the van

list.name: Private walking tour
list.price: $240 for up to 6 people, $30 each after that, up to 12
list.where: at a meeting point the group picks from the operator's list
list.before: a 25% deposit; the rest charged to the saved card when the guide texts DONE

list.name: School group walking tour
list.price: $12 a student; teachers and chaperones free
list.where: meets at the fountain on Market Square
list.after: one bill to the school after the tour
list.note: one adult chaperone for every 10 students, staying with the group

list.name: Private van tour with hotel pick-up
list.where: picked up at the group's hotel or home in the city (flow B)
list.before: a 25% deposit; the rest charged to the saved card when the guide texts DONE

list.name: Private shore excursion
list.length: 5 hours, back at the pier 1 hour before the ship's all-aboard time
list.where: picked up at the cruise pier (flow B)
list.note: the date can't move: it's the ship's day in port

list.name: Custom multi-day itinerary
list.price: quoted first from the group's answers (dates, size, interests)
list.where: picked up where the group stays (flow B)
list.before: a 30% deposit once the signed itinerary is back; the rest charged to the saved card at the end
list.note: Sam OKs each quote; hotels and flights are the group's own, outside Rosie

pf.services.capacity: seats per departure, set by the guide's group limit or the van's seat count; one guide per departure
pf.services.minimum: a public departure runs with its minimum (like 4 guests), counted 24 hours before; too few: Sam runs it or cancels, and each guest gets a full refund or another departure
pf.services.waitlist: a full departure keeps a waitlist; a freed seat goes by text to one person at a time
pf.services.skills: tour languages; the city areas and parks each guide may lead; who may drive which van; food tours, brewery walks, school groups
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the guests must be there
pf.services.walkIns: a walk-up guest takes a seat left on the next departure, at the meeting point, until it leaves
pf.services.notBookings: souvenirs, photos and drinks sold on a tour stay outside Rosie

beforeTimes: how many adults and children, and the children's ages (sets the price and the seats)
for a private tour: the group's size, and for a pick-up the kind of place (a hotel, a home or the cruise pier) and the area
for a shore excursion: the ship's name, the day in port and the all-aboard time
for the brewery walk: that everyone is 21 or older
for a school group: the number of students, their grade, and the number of chaperones
afterTime: anything the guide should know: walking pace, a stroller, a wheelchair or a cane, a service animal
the language the group prefers, where the departure offers more than one
securePage: each guest's name for the tour list (private tours and van tours)
food allergies, for a food tour
health or mobility details a guest wants the guide to know
an emergency contact for a full-day or multi-day tour
for a pick-up: the hotel or street address
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult; children come with an adult from the booking; a teacher or the school office books a school group; the brewery walk is for adults 21 and over only
pf.questions.told: the meeting point, the start time, the end point, the walking distance and any stairs, what to wear and bring, and that the tour leaves 10 minutes after the start

stop.words: someone unwell right now: chest pain, fainting, trouble breathing, signs of heat stroke
stop.say: Call 911 now. Move them to shade and give water if they can drink.

goOn.words: a guest uses a wheelchair, walks slowly, or is pregnant
goOn.what: the booking goes on; Rosie shares the tour's walking distance, stairs and rest stops from the operator's notes; no health advice

goOn.words: a severe food allergy on a food tour
goOn.what: noted on the secure page for the guide; the operator decides if its partner stops can serve the guest; Rosie never promises a safe meal

pf.safety.weather: lightning, a heat warning or high winds stop the outdoor part; light rain doesn't (rain or shine); the guide or Sam makes the call, before the day or at the meeting point
pf.safety.onTour: a guest hurt or sick on the tour: the guide helps, calls 911 if needed, and Sam is told; a child lost from the group: the guide calls 911 at once and keeps the rest of the group together
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, a medical emergency → 911 and no booking

steps.name: Park tour: the park permit
steps.when: on file before the date is offered
steps.result: no permit, no park tour on that date

steps.name: Entry tickets to sites on the route
steps.when: bought by the operator for each guest before the day
steps.who: Sam, a to-do with its due date
steps.result: a site's tickets not in hand: the stop is swapped and guests are told

steps.name: School group: the chaperone list
steps.when: on the secure page 3 days before
steps.result: a missing chaperone: the school's own adult is asked before the day

steps.name: Custom itinerary: the signed itinerary
steps.when: on the secure page before the deposit

pf.first_steps.prep: comfortable shoes, water, sun protection and a rain jacket; a photo ID for the brewery walk; be at the meeting point 10 minutes early

pf.visit.checkIn: at the meeting point the guide ticks names on the tour list, or takes the booker's code for the whole group; for a pick-up, the code in the hotel lobby
pf.visit.lateEntry: the tour leaves the meeting point 10 minutes after the start time; later than that, the guest missed it and the cancel terms apply; a private tour waits for its group but still ends at its set time
pf.visit.id: on the brewery walk every guest shows a photo ID; a guest under 21 or without an ID can't join, and only that guest is affected
pf.visit.changes: an extra stop or an extra hour on a private tour is priced first, and the group says yes; nothing is added on a public tour
pf.visit.leaveEarly: a guest who leaves a tour early pays the full price: the seat or the guide's time was theirs
pf.visit.done: the guide texts DONE at the end point

pf.money.before: public tours paid in full when booking; private tours a 25% deposit, with the rest charged to the saved card when the guide texts DONE; a shore excursion paid in full; the free tour takes nothing; a school group nothing before
pf.money.after: a school group gets one bill after the tour; everything else is settled before, or at DONE on the saved card
pf.money.cancel: public tours free to cancel up to 24 hours before; private tours 48 hours; later, or a no-show, the payment may be kept, only with Sam's yes
pf.money.operatorCancels: a tour called off for weather or too few guests: a full refund or another departure, the guest picks
pf.money.caps: deposits within the state's limits where they apply
pf.money.tips: tips are the guest's choice, in cash or the guide's own way; Rosie never asks for one
pf.money.tax: any sales or admissions tax the place requires, in the price before the yes
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies: one $2 per booking, however many seats
pf.money.noSale: souvenirs, photos and drinks are sold outside Rosie

pf.messages.never: guests' health, mobility or allergy details, children's names and ages, ID or passport numbers: only on the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: the guide's day list shows each booker's name and the number of guests; the tour list with names opens only on the guide's signed-in phone
pf.messages.languages: English and Spanish; each departure's tour language shown with it
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the parent or teacher who booked

pf.staff.licenses: a guide's local license where the area requires one; a driver's commercial license with a passenger endorsement and a current medical card for larger vans: the business's own word, never checked by Rosie
pf.staff.skills: tour languages, the areas and parks each guide may lead, who may drive which van, food tours, brewery walks, school groups
pf.staff.crews: a van tour needs a guide and a licensed driver (or one guide licensed to drive it); it can't run without a licensed driver
pf.staff.standIn: another guide with the same tour, language and area license; for a private tour where the group named a guide, the group is asked first, and nobody moves on silence
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs custom itineraries, private tour changes and refunds
pf.staff.ratio: one guide per public departure, up to its seat limit

pf.rules.showFacts: the meeting point, the end point, the length, the walking distance and the cancel terms before the yes; any license or permit number the area requires
pf.rules.cancelRight: no cancel period for a tour already given; a signed multi-day itinerary follows its signed terms
pf.rules.park: park tours only inside the permit's dates, places and group sizes
pf.rules.vehicles: every guest in a seat with a seatbelt; children in car seats where the rules require them, brought by the parent (the reminder says so)
pf.rules.travel: where the state's seller-of-travel rules apply (a multi-day itinerary sold ahead), money paid before goes to the account kept apart, or a bond
pf.rules.alcohol: brewery and tasting tours are for 21 and over; the partner serves; the guide stops service to a guest who seems drunk
pf.rules.records: the tour list for each departure kept with the booking for 7 years
pf.rules.reviews: a rating once after the tour

pf.edges.tooFew: too few guests 24 hours before: Sam runs it or cancels; each guest gets a full refund or another departure
pf.edges.weather: lightning, a heat warning or high winds: the outdoor part is called off by the guide or Sam, the day before or at the meeting point; a full refund or another departure
pf.edges.late: a late guest can join until the tour leaves the meeting point, 10 minutes after the start; later counts as a no-show
pf.edges.lostGuest: a guest who doesn't come back at a stop: the guide calls their mobile and waits up to 15 minutes, then the tour goes on and Sam is told
pf.edges.cruise: a shore excursion's date can't move: if the guide can't come, a stand-in guide or a full refund
pf.edges.guideOut: a public departure: Sam names the cover and guests aren't asked; a private tour where the group named a guide: the group is asked, and nobody moves on silence
pf.edges.driverOut: a van tour's driver can't come: another licensed driver, or the tour can't run
pf.edges.closedSite: a site on the route closed that day: the guide swaps a stop and the guests are told; if it's the tour's main site, a full refund or another day
pf.edges.minors: children with an adult from the booking; a school group with its chaperones
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

story.A: Alex books two adult seats on Saturday's 10am Old Town walking tour, paid in full. The group meets at the fountain on Market Square, and Mara ticks the names and leaves at 10:10. The tour ends at the old church at noon. Pick a money choice at the top to follow its path.
story.B: Sam Lee signs up two companies by text. Then Alex books a private van tour for a family of 5 with hotel pick-up: a 25% deposit when booking, and the rest charged to the saved card when the guide texts DONE. Hugo and Lena pick them up in the hotel lobby at 9am. Pick a money choice at the top to follow its path.

examples.list|none|bill: A school group: nothing before, and one bill to the school after the tour.

examples.list|full|none: A private shore excursion from the cruise pier, $620 for up to 6 people, paid in full when booking.

Base: the Oct 25 test-drive plug-in (work/testdrive/tours.md), kept where verified; re-verified on the REDESIGN 2 master (Oct 27). Sibling: gym (refit R07), class pattern.
D96: Rosie checks no guide license, driver license, permit or carrier number (pf.license says so; the test-drive's 'checked on the lookup' is removed).
Money: the rest of every deposit is charged to the saved card when the guide texts DONE (or the multi-day trip's end), never on a set day by itself (the test-drive's '7 days before' and '30 days before' are removed). Paths: A list|full|none (public seats, $35), A list|deposit|card (private walking tour, $240 with a $60 deposit), A list|none|counter (free walking tour), A list|none|bill (school group, one bill), B list|deposit|card (private van tour, $560, deposit $140), B list|full|none (shore excursion, $620, paid in full), B photos|deposit|card (custom itinerary quoted first, deposit $450). Fees are never more than the money paid now.
Names: Lee City Tours (flow A) and Lee Van Tours (flow B), both of Sam Lee; guides Mara and Tomas (A), Hugo and Lena (B, Lena the licensed driver); the example guest Alex M.
Facts: classes, groups, children, weather, permits, crews, multiday, proposals, contracts, firststeps. No switches. Settings: set start times; cancel free until 24 hours before (private tours 48 hours, the plug-in's own rule).
Not used: plans, packs, memberships, intro offers, online, drop-off, insurance, holds, sent-now work, on-call, stays.
